description: This file defines a PermissionRequester class for managing runtime permission requests within an Android application. It handles requesting permissions, showing rationales, guiding users to app settings, and managing the permission request flow with coroutines.

classes.name: PermissionRequester
classes.description: Handles Android runtime permission requests, including rationale display and navigating to app settings, with coroutine support for asynchronous handling.

methods.name: requestIfMissing
methods.description: Requests the specified permissions if they are not already granted. Shows rationale if needed and handles user responses, returning a map of permissions to granted status.

methods.name: showRationaleDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog explaining the rationale for permissions; suspends until user responds.

methods.name: showSettingsDialog
methods.description: Instructs the user to manually enable permissions in app settings via a dialog.

methods.name: buildRationaleMessage
methods.description: Constructs a user-friendly message explaining why permissions are needed.

methods.name: buildSettingsMessage
methods.description: Constructs a message prompting the user to enable permissions in app settings.

methods.name: permissionLabel
methods.description: Provides a human-readable label for a given permission string.
